Definition: from G3639; to spoil, i.e. slay:--destroy.
BiblicalUsage: Olothreuo means to destroy, to slay, the work of the destroyer. It occurs once, in Hebrews 11:28, where Moses keeps the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the blood on the doorpost is what stands between a household and the destroyer, and faith keeps the Passover still.
